title: Chat
description: Talk with the assistant, without opening a coworker.

list.label: Your chats
list.empty: No chats yet. Start one and it shows up here.

delete.title: Delete this chat?
delete.description: “{title}” and its whole conversation are erased for good, for you and for anyone you shared it with. This cannot be undone.

toasts.shared: Members of the workspace can now read this chat.
toasts.deletedOutdated: The chat is removed here. Its messages stay on your server, which runs an older version of Lumvika that cannot erase them.
toasts.deletedUnreachable: The chat is removed here. Its messages could not be erased from your server, which did not answer.

project.label: Project
project.hint: The assistant reads the project's instructions.

conversation.readOnly: Shared by {name}. Only they can write in this chat.
conversation.transcriptUnavailable: The messages of this chat cannot be read right now. Try again in a moment.

notFound.title: Chat not found
notFound.description: It was deleted, or it is not shared with you.

empty.title: What can I help with?
empty.description: Ask a question, draft a text or think something through. Your chats stay private unless you share them.

draftEmail.label: Draft an email
draftEmail.prompt: Help me draft a short, friendly email to a customer about a delayed delivery.

explain.label: Explain a concept
explain.prompt: Explain how a sales pipeline works, with a simple example.

brainstorm.label: Brainstorm ideas
brainstorm.prompt: Give me ten ideas for a LinkedIn post about our company this week.

summarize.label: Summarize a page
summarize.prompt: Summarize this page in five bullet points:

outdated.title: Update your server to use Chat
outdated.description: Your workspace server runs an older version of Lumvika. Chat works once it is updated.

noEngine.title: Chat needs a server
noEngine.description: Your workspace has no server yet. It gets one when you add your first coworker.

unreachable.title: Your server is not answering
unreachable.description: Chat runs on your workspace server, which cannot be reached right now.

noProvider.title: Connect an AI provider
noProvider.description: Chat needs a model to answer. Connect a provider or a subscription to start.
